fix(ui): the ribbon's section and machine doors wear glyphs

With no pinned operations (every fresh install) the Create run of the
ribbon was text-only: the section dropdown doors and the machine door
carried no glyph by design, which users read as missing icons. Each
section door now wears its family's op glyph and the machine door its
workspace's, all from the existing set; the View door stays text.
Shell snapshots move by those glyphs.

Fixes #207

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(ui): a refusal on the status strip is drawn as an alert

When the status line carries a refusal - a command refused through the
feedback path, a dark cell's "cannot ..." note, or one of the shell's
refusal phrasings - the strip draws it in the error ink, bold, behind a
"!" marker on an error-tinted band, until the next status replaces it.
Ordinary status text stays dim.

Fixes #192

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(ui): routine status reads in the body ink; "not created" is a refusal

The status strip drew routine messages in egui's dim "weak" grey,
near-invisible on the dark strip (#215). They now use the theme's body
text ink, pinned against the strip fill by the body-text contrast gate
in both built-in themes. "not created:" joins the refusal phrasings so
an operation-create refusal is an alert on any path. Shell snapshots
move by the brighter status line.

Fixes #215
